subject: Re: DPA and SCCs — FinLedger procurement & signature path
messages:
From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@finledger.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finledger.com
Date: 2027-05-09T08:13:00Z
Subject: DPA and SCCs — initial redlines and evidence request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — FinLedger is excited to move forward. Attached is our initial DPA redline (FinLedger_DPA_v1_redline.docx) and the SCCs annex we need included. A couple of priority asks from our side:

- Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 evidence (latest report) or provide a SOC 2 letter?
- We need a completed DPIA questionnaire for our EU data protection team (attached template).
- Retention: Procurement is flagging a retention cap for financial data — they requested clarification/negotiation on clause 4.3.

Procurement would also like to confirm the signing path: FinLedger prefers signature by the EU subsidiary first, then Redwood US entity countersigns. If you have an EU-compliant e-sign provider (VaultSign is our standard), please let us know if that works.

We also requested a short list of subprocessors and a pointer to your SCCs annex (if different from the attached).

Attaching: FinLedger_DPA_v1_redline.docx, SCCs_Annex_v3.pdf, DPIA_Questionnaire_FinLedger.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Arielle Thompson
Legal Operations | FinLedger Inc.
arielle@finledger.com

Hi Arielle — thanks for the materials, got them.

I'll coordinate internally and come back with:
- SOC 2 attestation (or letter) and where we can share artifacts securely.
- Proposed edits on retention clause 4.3 and a suggested alternative that keeps us compliant with regulator-facing retention for EU financial data.
- Confirmation on subprocessor list and SCCs annex alignment.

I'm looping in Legal (Laura), Privacy (Neha) and Security (Marcus). Ben from Sales Operations will handle procurement/discount coordination.

On signing: VaultSign for the EU entity + Redwood countersign is fine in principle; we'll confirm our side's routing and whether we need an additional cross-border rider.

Target: draft response + internal action items by EOD Monday (2027-05-10). If you have a hard deadline from procurement, please share.

—Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Team — forwarding FinLedger's redlines and annex. Quick assignment so we don't lose momentum:

- Marcus: review SCCs_Annex_v3.pdf and confirm if there are any non-starters (encryption, logging, or entitlements). Propose fallback language if required.
- Neha: review FinLedger_DPA_v1_redline.docx and draft our counterproposal on retention clause 4.3; confirm whether a 7-year cap is acceptable for EU financial data or if we need a carve-out.
- Laura: lead legal signoff and prepare a one-pager exec summary for our CRO if an exec escalation is needed.
- Ben: own procurement coordination — track their discount/credit ask tied to implementation SLAs and confirm procurement contact.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: FW: DPA and SCCs — FinLedger materials (action items)

Jordan / team — skimmed SCCs annex and flagged the items below (see inline notes in SCCs_Annex_v3.pdf):

- Logging & access: Annex requires 24-month audit logs retention for privilege escalations — that's longer than our default. Recommend: 12 months with on-request extended retention for investigations.
- Subprocessors: FinLedger wants prior written notice + 30-day objection window; propose notification + acceptance unless a material risk is raised.
- Cross-border: Annex references EU->US transfer clause that will require our signed SCCs + mention of EU entity boundary.

Retention callout: regarding 4.3 — if procurement insists on a hard 7-year cap, that will conflict with certain regulatory obligations for financial data (some jurisdictions require longer for AML). Need Neha to confirm acceptable language.

Attaching: SCCs_comments_marcus.txt (inline commentary). Happy to join a call with FinLedger security if helpful.

—Marcus
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@finledger.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, procurement@finledger.com
Cc: Michael Sanger <michael.sanger@vaultsign.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA and SCCs — clarification on retention + signing

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement asked me to clarify a couple of points:

- Retention: Procurement would be comfortable with a 7-year maximum for EU financial records, provided there is a short list of lawful exceptions (e.g., ongoing investigations, legal holds). Will Redwood accept limited exceptions?
- DPIA: I've attached our team's DPIA questionnaire; can you have your privacy team complete and return?
- Signing: VaultSign is our preferred e-sign partner for the EU entity; Michael Sanger (cc) is their implementation contact. He can spin up an envelope for the EU signature flow if Redwood confirms the email addresses and the counter-signature step.

Procurement contact: procurement@finledger.com — they asked for a DocuSign or VaultSign envelope to expedite. There is also a request to include an SLA credit if onboarding milestones slip more than 15 days.

Attaching updated redline: FinLedger_DPA_v2_redline.docx

Look forward to your counterproposal.

Best,
Arielle

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Thompson <arielle@finledger.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finledger.com>, Michael Sanger <michael.sanger@vaultsign.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA and SCCs — agreed path for evidence & signature routing

Arielle / Procurement / Michael — per internal review we've put together a proposed path and timeline: 

1) Privacy & retention: Neha will provide counterlanguage to 4.3 that accepts a 7-year cap for EU financial data with explicit carve-outs for legal holds and regulator-prescribed retention. Expect Neha's text by 2027-05-13 12:00 UTC.

2) SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II attestation and a secure link to a read-only artifact; Laura will coordinate a secure transfer and a nondisclosure access ticket.

3) DPIA: Neha will complete the DPIA questionnaire and return it alongside the counterproposal.

4) Signing flow: Michael — if VaultSign can create an envelope that targets FinLedger EU entity first and then routes to contracts@redwood.com for countersignature, we're good to proceed. If VaultSign cannot do the routing, we'll provide a DocuSign alternative. Please coordinate with Ben on the envelope (ben_carter@redwood.com).

5) SLA credits: Ben will handle the procurement ask about onboarding milestone credits — we will propose a limited credit tied to implementation delays beyond 30 days (rather than 15), as a compromise.

Next steps: Neha + Marcus + Laura will finalize the counterproposal and attachments; Ben will confirm procurement terms; I will send the consolidated package for FinLedger review on 2027-05-14 AM. If FinLedger needs earlier, flag and we'll escalate to CRO.

Forwarded for visibility: previous thread.

Thanks — Jordan
